key_insight: TPPO replaces a standard PPO critic with a cumulative, prefix-tracking value model that better follows token-level value evolution under sparse terminal rewards.
engineering_relevance: This improves reasoning-policy training stability and credit assignment for LLMs, yielding stronger math reasoning and better out-of-distribution generalization across model sizes and tasks.
method: Model successive prefix values with a Bayesian decomposition in log-odds space
Predict position-wise scalar outputs and sum them into value logits
Train the reconstructed values using terminal-outcome supervision
evidence_signal: The abstract reports aggregate math reasoning gains of +7.0 on Qwen3-4B-Base and +8.4 on Qwen3-8B-Base, with improvements also on Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B, countdown, and scientific coding tasks.
watch_item: Because the method relies on reconstructed cumulative value logits and terminal supervision, it may be sensitive to value calibration and implementation details in sparse-reward settings.
paper_title: TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning
